base_42.note: Positive-point NLO-only prefix runtimes are overwritten in final TSV; future diagnostics now record them. At about 0.25 s each, corrected reduction remains about 45%.

adversarial_interpolation_8.warning: All interpolated points became strict positives, so this set expands positive-domain coverage but did not create the intended new negative boundary cases.

e6_mixed_bounce_neighborhood.routing_conclusion: All eight required exact fallback; final-output timing excludes the wasted approximate first pass and must not be claimed as speedup. The exact-direct protection radius was enlarged to 2.5e-4 to cover this validated mixed neighborhood.

secondary_observation: The current E4 strict reference and v2/v3 outputs have incompatible transition schemas, so their same-index SNR amplitudes must not be compared. The earlier 9/10 figure was a stale-reference artifact; amplitude accuracy remains unproven there.
